## Invariants and adversarial cases

## Authority and scope

Review, CI, model confidence, popularity, and witness reports do not grant merge authority.

## Admission checklist

- [ ] The PR is anchored to an attributable proposal issue.
- [ ] The manifest uses `project0.construction-manifest.v0`.
- [ ] The manifest records the exact base revision.
- [ ] Before issue #5 is resolved, identity is `provisional` and `canonicalHash` is `null`.
- [ ] No Git SHA, URL, UUID, timestamp, or placeholder digest is claimed as Project 0 canonical identity.
- [ ] No new ontology or receipt semantics are hidden in implementation code.
- [ ] Provenance, disclosure constraints, authorship, rejection, and uncertainty remain recoverable.
- [ ] Verification outputs are kept distinct from truth, occurrence, witness, and authority.
- [ ] Compatibility and migration effects are stated.
- [ ] Stop conditions were checked.
